answer: An exhibition agent buys thread, marble, and glacier photographs from a cooperative. To limit fake suppliers, give each independently vetted sponsor ten nonrenewable admission slots. A shared registry consumes one slot per invitation; invited accounts receive no new slots, and key replacement preserves the sponsor's used-slot count. A clone cannot recursively invite more clones, so one corrupt sponsor admits at most ten identities. Expanding access requires another independently approved sponsor. This bounds Sybil entry but trusts sponsor vetting and can exclude legitimate newcomers.
